title: Fraud reports and suspicious banking contact - support procedure
content: The synthetic security workflow records the masked report and escalates to an agent with high priority. If a real credential or payment may be compromised, act through the institution's verified fraud process; this assistant cannot recover funds or investigate actual accounts.
